Q: Unable to flush stdout: Bad file descriptor A:

The following is the correct syntax:

open3( '<&STDIN', '>&STDOUT', ... )

Q: How can I use an Android library that is available as a maven artifact "by hand" without using a build management system? A:

Download the dependency from their maven repository. Which is all the build system is going to do. Of course without the build system, you'll need to figure out the static URL to download, and may have to manually update it for any future versions. Your choice on whether to download it once and add it to version control, or to write a more sophisticated build script that downloads it each time.

Although really, unless you're trying to learn how to write a build system, just use one. THey may be a bit slower, but you'll spend far more than that keeping your homemade script up to date.

Q: New Relic Cassandra integration shows only a few keyspaces/tables (29), how to monitor all? A:

Cassandra generates table-level metrics for:

  • coordinator

  • replica

For each table, there are:

  • Read Latency

  • Write Latency

  • Range Read Latency

  • Read Throughput

  • Write Throughput

  • Range Read Throughput

For each latency type, there are the following metrics:

min, 50thPercentile, 75thPercentile, 95thPercentilel, 99thPercentile, 999thPercentile, Max

The above set alone generates 48 metrics per table, per node, and you can imagine that the volume of metrics can quickly build up with the number of tables.

Also, these metrics are just the beginning. There are many more per table, like "estimated partition count", "tombstones scanned (with all the percentiles)", "max table partition size", "mean partition size", "max live SSTables", "SStables read (with all the percentiles", "bloom filter", and this is not an exhaustive list.

The default number of tables New Relic collects is 20, and it is configured in cassandra-config.yml, with the parameter COLUMN_FAMILIES_LIMIT.

Do consider the bill going up when you increase this limit.

Alternatively, consider using AxonOps as it collects all table metrics at 5 seconds resolution where as New Relic is every 60 seconds.
